title: The French Test
question: How long did the exam last?

meanings.usage: 与exam同义，日常生活中更常用
指在考试或测试中取得合格成绩
指在考试中没有达到及格标准
指提问或需要回答的内容
形容需要努力才能完成的事
形容非常不好或令人不悦的事物
cheer up表示让人高兴起来
表示满足某种需要的程度

phrases.usage: 用于询问某事持续了多长时间

examples.en: How long did the exam last?
How long did the meeting last?
How was the exam? Not too bad.
I think I passed in English.
I think I failed the French paper.
I could answer sixteen of the questions.

phrases.usage: 表示对某人来说太...（而不适合）

examples.en: They were too difficult for me.
The exam was too hard for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
examples.zh: 试卷对我来说不够简单。

examples.en: Oh, cheer up!

phrases.usage: 表示做得还不错，不是很糟糕

examples.en: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.

phrases.usage: 写一个字（强调什么都没写）

examples.en: He didn't write a word!
I hate them.

sentences.en: How was the exam, Richard?
Not too bad.
I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
sentences.zh: 我想我英语和数学都及格了。

sentences.en: The questions were very easy.
How about you, Gary?
The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
sentences.zh: 英语和数学试卷对我来说都不够简单。

sentences.en: I hope I haven't failed.
I think I failed the French paper.
I could answer sixteen of the questions.
They were very easy.
But I couldn't answer the rest.
sentences.zh: 但我回答不了剩下的题。

sentences.en: They were too difficult for me.
French tests are awful, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 法语考试糟透了，不是吗？

sentences.en: I hate them.
I'm sure I've got a low mark.
Oh, cheer up!
Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
sentences.zh: 也许我们考得没那么糟。

sentences.en: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
sentences.zh: 我旁边那个家伙在试卷顶部写了他的名字。

sentences.en: Yes?
Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
sentences.zh: 然后他坐在那里看了三个小时！

sentences.en: He didn't write a word!

exercises.prompt: “使振作，使高兴” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: cheer · /tʃɪər/ · verb · 使振作，使高兴。cheer up表示让人高兴起来

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：也许，可能
exercises.explain: perhaps · /pərˈhæps/ · adv · 也许，可能。表示不确定或可能性

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：How was the exam? _____.
exercises.explain: Not too bad：表示还不错，还可以（考试怎么样？还不错。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：Then he sat _____ and looked at it for three hours!
exercises.hint: 然后他坐在那里看了三个小时！
exercises.explain: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours! — 然后他坐在那里看了三个小时！

source.en: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!

exercises.prompt: “表达'太...而不能'和'足够...可以'的含义” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: too + 形容词 + (for sb) + to do sth / 形容词 + enough + (for sb) + to do sth
options: may/might 与 be going to 的区别
exercises.explain: too...to 与 enough...to 结构：too + 形容词 + (for sb) + to do sth / 形容词 + enough + (for sb) + to do sth：too...to表示否定含义，enough...to表示肯定含义

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
The questions were very easy.
options: 我能等，但我的牙痛不能等！
马什小姐，您刚拍了一部新电影吗？
exercises.explain: The questions were very easy. — 题目很简单。

grammar.title: 一般过去时特殊疑问句
grammar.definition: 询问过去发生的事情的时间、原因、方式等信息的疑问句
grammar.structure: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？
grammar.usage: 用于询问过去动作的具体信息，如时间、原因等

examples.en: How long did the exam last?
What did you do yesterday?
When did she leave?

grammar.title: too...to 与 enough...to 结构
grammar.definition: 表达'太...而不能'和'足够...可以'的含义
grammar.structure: too + 形容词 + (for sb) + to do sth / 形容词 + enough + (for sb) + to do sth
grammar.usage: too...to表示否定含义，enough...to表示肯定含义

examples.en: They were too difficult for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
examples.zh: 试卷对我来说不够简单。

examples.en: The book is easy enough to read.
examples.zh: 这本书足够简单，可以阅读。

examples.en: He is too young to go to school.

grammar.title: 情态动词 could 的用法
grammar.definition: could 表示过去的能力或可能性
grammar.structure: 主语 + could + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 表示过去能够做某事（能力）或能够做到某事（可能性）

examples.en: I could answer sixteen of the questions.
I couldn't answer the rest.
Could you speak English then?

patterns.pattern: How long did + 主语 + 动词原形 + (其他)?

original.en: How long did the exam last?

examples.en: How long did the movie last?
How long did the trip last?

patterns.pattern: 主语 + think + 主语 + passed/failed + in + 科目

original.en: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
original.zh: 我想我英语和数学通过了。

examples.en: I think I passed in History.
She thinks she failed in Physics.

patterns.pattern: too + 形容词 + for + 人称代词/名词

original.en: They were too difficult for me.

examples.en: This problem is too hard for students.
examples.zh: 这个问题对学生来说太难了。

examples.en: The book is too boring for children.
examples.zh: 这本书对孩子来说太无聊了。

patterns.pattern: 形容词 + enough + (for + 人称代词/名词) + to do sth

original.en: The English paper wasn't easy enough for me.
original.zh: 英语试卷对我来说不够简单。

examples.en: The seat isn't comfortable enough for him.
examples.zh: 这个座位对他来说不够舒服。

examples.en: The room is big enough for five people.
examples.zh: 这个房间足够大，可以容纳五个人。
